text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I spot Seiun Sky during lunch time. Just as I'm about to call out to her…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sei, that thing you gave me the other day was so cool! I feel like a million bucks!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Heh! There are other amazing products too. I've been making serious bank. Want me to get some of those too?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Please! Oh, hold on! Is it okay if I tell some of my friends?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sure thing. That way everyone benefits. You just go ahead and spread the good news! See ya.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What a shady exchange. I mull over whether I should say something when…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sky! Stop your dubious dealings!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa! You scared me there! I dunno what you're talking about though.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Don't play the fool! "Making bank," "spread the good news"! It's crystal clear what you're up to!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …Ohhh, I get it. You mean that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Welp, this is bad. I'm busted… Gumshoe King has done it again.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You are sorely mistaken if you think you can get away with this on my watch! Now, clean up your act and—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wait, before that. Do you actually have any kind of proof?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Hm?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, you are a detective, right? I'm guessing you've got some decisive evidence or whatever?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Of… of course I have! Don't underestimate my skills in investigation!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I'm really shaking in my boots now. Guess I'd better get my affairs in order.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ngh… fine, have it your way. I'll do whatever it takes to catch you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …You over there! Sky's trainer! You've been eavesdropping all the while!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Assist with my investigation! You're concerned about Sky too, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: As such, I shall grant you the right to suggest a means of obtaining evidence! Now, speak!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Surveillance, I see! In that case, we must begin at once!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Phew! Okay, one more lap to go.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sky is training by herself? How suspicious! Something must be afoot!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wait a sec, is that… Gumshoe King? I see my trainer's acting as your Watson, then.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: It's rather rare for you to be training so diligently… This means you're clearly up to something!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I guess it might look a little off… but what could lil' ol' me possibly be up to?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Th-that would be, um… the illicit manufacturing of skill-enhancing cleats! Or some such!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Wait a moment—this is a diversion! You've distracted me with your individual training while some shady deal is underway elsewhere!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Boy oh boy, that's some imaginative deducing there. Gotta hand it to you, King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! But of course! Now, accept your defeat!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, sure. But maybe you'd better accept yours first? If you'd kindly look this way…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: These are from back home. They're our prized veggies.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What?! You've just been handing out vegetables?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yep. I got a boatload of them sent from home. I'm overflowing with energy from all the nutrients I've been getting.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wh-why didn't you tell me?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, let's just say I wanted to see how much detecting the great Dumbshoe King was actually capable of… Catch ya later!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: W-w-wait right there! Skyyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo chases after Seiun Sky, and I'm left speechless as I watch the two of them running off…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I see! Concrete proof would be more reliable than mere scraps of evidence we might find here or there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We meet up with some of King Halo's pals and arrange a stakeout…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Boy, I'm beat… It sure isn't easy lugging this around all day long.

text_block_list.name: Bob Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Umm… King? This is Point A. Sky is currently resting. From what I can tell, she's got a suspicious bag under her arm.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: All right, this is our chance! All units, proceed!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Accept your defeat, Sky! You've been caught red-handed!

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: We've got you surrounded!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yikes! It's the King Detective Agency!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so the contents of the dubious bag are inspected…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wh-what is this? There's nothing but vegetables in here…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: And that's precisely all I've been handing out, vegetables sent to me from back home. My parents are farmers.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Impossible… Was this all brought about by my own misunderstanding?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh, well, you sure put on a heck of a show, Dumbshoe King.

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Oh man… Still, those vegetables look really delicious, Sky.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, I can drop some off for you later. I've got loads.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Guess that means one more place to stop by on my delivery run. That's great muscle training and all, but it'll sure be tough.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I could really use some assistance… Maybe from a certain someone who suspected I was up to no good.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: O-oh fine! By way of an apology, I'll help you out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, with King Halo's help, Seiun Sky finishes handing out all her vegetables after a few days.
